The '''''Merry Thrubidor''''' was a [[720 light freighter/Legends|720 light freighter]] manufactured by [[Ghtroc Industries/Legends|Ghtroc Industries]]. It was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[operative]]s to retrieve stolen cargo from [[Pirates of Prexiar|pirates]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Prexiar]].<ref name="Pirates" />
